Pockets POS is a point of sale and back office for shops, bars, hardware stores and other retailers in Zimbabwe. It sells, keeps stock, manages cash and customers, and issues ZIMRA fiscal receipts. This manual walks every user through the system, one role at a time.

Web system

Runs in any browser. The back office for managers and admins, plus the Web POS selling screen.

Windows desktop till

Pockets POS for Windows. Sells with or without internet and sends its sales to the web system when it is online.

ZIMRA fiscalisation

Every sale is a signed fiscal invoice and every refund a credit note, sent to ZIMRA automatically.

Who does what

RoleWho it is forWhat they can do
TillCashiersSell, print receipts, request refunds, cash in / out, count the till and close it. Own branch only.
SupervisorShift leadersEverything a Till user can do, plus approve refunds and run the ZIMRA fiscal day.
ManagementShop managers, ownersEverything a Supervisor can do, plus dashboards, sales, stock, cash and tax reports, ZIMRA receipts and refund checks.
AdminThe business administratorEverything: products, stock, purchasing, customers, users, tax rates, ZIMRA devices, backups and desktop tills, for all branches.
Super AdminPocket Solutions (the provider)Sets up companies and publishes desktop till updates. Never sells or refunds.
01

Getting started

Everyone

Signing in

  1. Open the web address your administrator gave you in Chrome, Edge or any modern browser.
  2. Enter your email or username and your password, then press Login Now.
  3. Till users go straight to the selling screen. Everyone else lands on Admin Home.
Security. After 5 wrong passwords the account is paused for 15 minutes. You are signed out after 10 minutes without activity. Change your password any time from Password at the bottom of the menu.

Finding your way around

The menu on the left groups the pages: Sell, Reports, Till & Cash, Products & Stock, Purchasing, Customers & Accounts, Finance and Admin. You only see the pages your role allows.

  • Search menu at the top finds any page by name. Type a product name and press Enter to search products.
  • Switch branch changes the branch you are working in, for users allowed more than one branch.
  • The tiles on Admin Home are shortcuts to the most used pages.
02

Selling at the till

Till

This chapter is for cashiers. The same steps work on the Web POS and on the Windows desktop till.

1. Open the till

  1. Open Web POS from the menu.
  2. Tap Till at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Count the cash in the drawer and enter it as the Opening float, then tap Open Session.
The daily routine is always: Open → Sell → Reconcile → Close. If a till is left open overnight the screen reminds you to reconcile and close it.

2. Ring up a sale

  • Tap + on a product tile to add one. Tap − to take one away.
  • Tap the number between − and + to type a quantity, e.g. 12. Enter 0 to remove the item.
  • Search or scan: type a name, product ID or barcode in the box at the top, or scan the barcode.
  • Items sold by weight or length (kg, m, litres) always ask for the amount, e.g. 1.25 kg.
  • Items with sizes or colours open a picker so you can choose the right one.

3. Choose the customer (optional)

Sales go to Cash Customer unless you pick someone. Tap Customer, search by name, phone or code, and choose them. To sell on account (credit), the customer needs an active customer account.

4. Take payment

  1. Tap Print / Submit or Place Order. The payment screen opens.
  2. Choose the payment method: Cash, Card, EcoCash, Bank transfer, Account (credit) or Other.
  3. Enter the amount paid, or tap Exact or a quick amount such as $100. The change is shown.
  4. Tap Confirm Payment. The receipt prints, with the ZIMRA QR code and verification code when the branch is fiscalised.

5. Reprint a receipt

Open Receipts, search by customer or date, and tap Print next to the invoice.

6. Cash in and cash out

Use Cash In / Out for money added to or taken out of the drawer that is not a sale: float top-ups, cash drops to the safe, small payments. Choose Cash in or Cash out, enter the amount and reason, and save. Movements cannot be edited afterwards, so check before saving.

7. Count the till (reconciliation)

Before closing, count the cash and enter it on Cash Reconciliation. The system compares your count with the expected cash: opening float + cash sales + cash in − cash refunds − cash out. Any shortage or surplus is recorded.

8. Close the till

Open Close Till and confirm. Closing needs a current reconciliation, and it cannot be undone. The next cashier opens a new session.

9. Ask for a refund

  1. Open Refunds and enter the receipt number.
  2. Choose the items and quantities being returned and send the request.
  3. A Supervisor, Manager or Admin approves it and processes the refund. Cash refunds come out of the till; stock goes back on the shelf; a ZIMRA credit note is issued.
03

Supervisor tasks

Supervisor

Approving refunds

Every refund goes Request → Approve → Process. Open Refunds, open the waiting request, check the items, and choose Approve (with a note) or Reject. Then Process it to pay the customer and return the stock. Quantities are locked once approved; to change them, reject and ask for a new request.

The ZIMRA fiscal day

ZIMRA requires every fiscal device to work in fiscal days. Pockets POS handles most of this for you:

  • The fiscal day opens automatically with the first sale. Nobody has to open it.
  • Close the fiscal day at the end of trading, every day, from ZIMRA Fiscal Day › Close fiscal day.
  • The page shows the day number, when it opened and the hours left before ZIMRA's limit (usually 24 hours). The status bar warns in the last 3 hours.
  • If the day reaches the limit, sales stop until it is closed. ZIMRA does not allow signing past the limit.
  • Send waiting receipts now pushes any receipts that could not reach ZIMRA earlier.
If ZIMRA cannot be reached, keep selling. Receipts are signed on the spot, printed with their QR code, and sent automatically when ZIMRA answers again. Only closing the day has to wait until ZIMRA is reachable.
04

Reports for managers

Management

Managers see live figures for the branches they are allowed. Reports can be filtered by date and branch, and most export to CSV or PDF.

Management Dashboard

Sales, stock, cash and refunds for a period at a glance, with operational alerts such as tills left open or receipts waiting for ZIMRA.

Sales Reports

Every sale by date, branch, cashier, product and payment method, plus refunds and cancelled sales. Click an invoice to open it.

Z Report

Sales by cashier for a day or date range: the end-of-day summary. Print it or save it as a PDF.

Inventory Reports

Stock on hand, low stock, out of stock and stock movements, with stock value at cost.

Cash Management

Expected cash in every open till, cash sales, cash in and out, shortages and surpluses, by cashier, till and branch. From here you also reach the Cash Movements, Reconciliation and Till Closure reports and the Cash Audit history.

ZIMRA Fiscal Receipts

Every fiscal invoice and credit note with its fiscal day, receipt number, status at ZIMRA and verification code.

Refund Reconciliation

Checks that every processed refund has the matching stock return and cash refund, and lists anything that does not add up so it can be reviewed. It only reads; it never changes your records.

05

Running the business (Admin)

Admin

Admins set the system up and keep it running. This chapter follows the order you would set up a new shop.

Users

Open Users › Create user. Enter the person's name and phone, an email address or a simple username (e.g. tendai.m), a password, their role (Till, Supervisor, Management or Admin) and their branch. Accounts can be locked when someone leaves; history is never deleted.

Products

  • Items lists products for the working branch. Search, filter by button group and edit prices in place. Inactive items stay for history but are hidden from the till.
  • Create item: name, optional barcode, selling and cost price, tax code, category and button group. The product ID is given automatically.
  • Import Items loads many products at once from the Excel template.
  • Bulk Price Change raises or lowers many prices together. Barcode Labels prints shelf labels.
  • Categories & Groups: categories group products in reports; button groups are the coloured buttons cashiers tap on the till. Set their colour and order here.

Stock

  • Opening Stock sets the starting quantity for each product.
  • Goods Receipt (GRV) books in deliveries from suppliers, with or without a purchase order. Stock goes up when goods are received.
  • Stock Adjustment corrects quantities (damage, expiry, theft, count differences) with a reason.
  • Stock Transfers move stock between branches.
  • Stock Take prints a count sheet and records counted quantities against the system quantity.
  • Stock Movements and Product History show every change to a product.

Purchasing

Keep Suppliers, raise Purchase Orders and receive them through Goods Receipt. Purchase orders do not change stock until the goods arrive. Purchase Returns send goods back. Purchasing Reports summarise spend by supplier and product.

Customers and accounts

Customers keeps your customer list. To sell on credit, open a Customer Account for the customer and set a limit. Record payments in Account Payments, print statements, and follow up debtors with Receivables Ageing, Credit Control and Collection Activity.

Finance

  • Expenses records business costs.
  • Tax Rates holds VAT and other rates (e.g. VAT 15.5%, prices inclusive). Each product gets a tax code; it decides the VAT on receipts and ZIMRA invoices.
  • Tax Reports and Accounting Export give your accountant what they need.

ZIMRA device setup

Each branch has one ZIMRA fiscal device. Copy the device ID, serial number and activation key from the ZIMRA portal, choose Test or Production, and register. When the status shows Fiscalising, every sale on that branch is a fiscal invoice.

Desktop tills

To add a Windows till: open Desktop Tills, choose the branch, give the till a name (e.g. Front counter) and press Add till. Press Pairing code and enter that code on the PC (see the Desktop till chapter). The list shows when each till was last seen and how many sales it has synced. Revoke disconnects a lost or replaced PC. Sync Differences lists offline sales that differed from the server, such as an old price.

Backup & Recovery

The web system backs up its database automatically and keeps a set number of copies. Run database backup now takes one on demand. Health checks show the last backup and storage status.

06

Selling and paying in other currencies

Everyone

A company can sell in more than one currency, for example US dollars and ZiG. Every company has one base currency. Prices are kept in the base and totals and reports are shown in it. Other currencies are converted with the exchange rate your manager enters.

Selling in another currency (cashiers)

  1. On the selling screen, choose the currency in the currency box under the till line before adding items. It only appears when your company uses more than one currency.
  2. Prices on screen change to that currency. The rate in use is shown next to the box, for example 1 USD = 26.50 ZWG.
  3. Take payment in the same currency. Change is given in that currency too.
  4. The receipt shows the amounts in that currency (the exchange rate is kept with the sale but not printed). On fiscal branches the ZIMRA receipt is issued in the same currency.
Rate changed? If a manager changes the rate while you are serving, the till tells you and updates the prices. Check the new total with the customer, then pay again.

Counting and closing the till

  • Each currency has its own drawer total. Cash Reconciliation shows one tab per currency in your drawer: count each one.
  • Close Till lists every currency. The till closes only when every currency has a count that is still current.
  • Cash in / out: choose the currency before the amount.

Refunds

There is nothing to choose. A refund is always paid back in the currency the customer paid in, at the rate of the original sale.

Customer accounts

  • When opening an account, pick its Account currency. It cannot be changed later. Credit sales must be made in it.
  • When a customer pays in another currency, choose Received in on the payment page. The amount is converted at today's rate and the balance stays in the account currency.

Purchasing and expenses

Purchase orders, goods received without an order, and expenses each have a Currency box. Choose the currency the supplier invoiced in. Goods received against an order use the order's currency.

Exchange rates (Management and Admin)

  1. Open Finance › Exchange Rates.
  2. Add a rate as 1 [base] = x [currency] and the date and time it starts. You can enter future rates in advance.
  3. A rate is never edited. To fix a mistake, Retire the wrong rate with a reason and add the correct one. Sales already made keep the rate they used.
  4. Use Check a conversion to see what an amount converts to at any time.
The list of currencies, each company's base currency and which currencies a company may use are set by Pocket Solutions (Super Admin), under Platform › Currencies. Desktop tills receive currencies and rates when they sync.
07

Platform (Super Admin)

Super Admin

Super Admin accounts belong to Pocket Solutions, the provider. They work across all client companies and cannot sell or refund on any till.

  • Companies: create a client company and its first Admin, or open a company to support it.
  • Super Admins: manage provider staff accounts.
  • Units of Measure: the shared list of units (kg, g, litres, metres…).
  • Desktop Releases: upload a new version of the Windows till. Tills update themselves.
  • Platform Activity: a log of provider actions.
08

The Windows desktop till

Everyone

Pockets POS for Windows is a full till that runs on the shop PC. It keeps its own copy of products, users and customers, so it keeps selling when the internet is down, and it sends its sales to the web system as soon as it is back online.

Installing

  1. Run PocketsPOS-Setup.exe on the till PC (Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit).
  2. Start Pockets POS. The first screen is Set up this PC.
  3. In the web system, an Admin opens Desktop Tills, adds a till for the branch and presses Pairing code.
  4. On the PC, enter the server address and the pairing code, and connect. The till downloads the company once: users, products and prices, customers and stock.

Daily use

  • Sign in with the same username and password as the web system. Signing in works offline.
  • Open the till with the opening float, then sell exactly as on the Web POS: tap tiles, +/−, tap the number to type a quantity, search or scan, choose a customer, take payment.
  • The status line at the top shows the connection, sales waiting to sync, and the ZIMRA fiscal day.
  • Reports, refunds, cash in / out, reconciliation and closing the till are in the back office, by role, just like the web.

Till Settings (Admin)

  • Printing: print through the Windows printer driver, send ESC/POS commands straight to a receipt printer, or print to a network printer by IP address. Choose 58 mm or 80 mm paper, copies and automatic paper cut. Test print checks it.
  • Cash drawer: drawers plugged into the receipt printer open automatically for cash sales and refunds. Choose pin 2 or pin 5. Every opening is logged.
  • Appearance: pick the primary and secondary colours of the till screens.
  • Updates: the till checks for new versions on the web server, or in a shared folder or USB stick, and installs them with one click. The previous version is kept in case you need to roll back.
  • Shop network: several tills in one shop can share sales and stock over the local network. One PC is the main till; the others join it with a code. Each till still works on its own if the network drops.

Your data on the till

  • Everything is saved on the PC's hard drive the moment a sale completes. Switching the PC off, or a power cut, does not lose completed sales.
  • A backup is made automatically each time a till is closed and once a day. The last 30 are kept. Set the backup folder to a USB drive or network folder to protect against a failed or stolen PC.
  • An Admin can restore a backup from Backup & Recovery; the app restarts to complete it.
A small UPS (battery backup) on the till PC is recommended. It is not needed to protect data, but it stops a power cut from interrupting a sale or the close of a ZIMRA fiscal day.
09

Questions and fixes

Everyone
ZIMRA could not be reached. Can we still sell?
Yes. Receipts are signed and printed straight away and sent to ZIMRA automatically when it answers. Close the fiscal day once ZIMRA is reachable again.
Sales have stopped: "The ZIMRA fiscal day has reached its time limit."
A Supervisor, Manager or Admin must close the fiscal day on ZIMRA Fiscal Day. The next sale opens a new day. Close the day every evening to avoid this.
A product does not show on the till.
Check in Items that it is Active, has a price and belongs to a button group. On a desktop till, wait for the next sync or download the company again.
The cash count does not match.
Check Cash In / Out for missing entries and card or EcoCash payments recorded as cash. Card, EcoCash and account payments are not counted as till cash.
I forgot my password.
Ask your Admin to set a new one in Users. Change it yourself afterwards from Password.
The desktop till was offline all day.
Nothing to do. The sales are kept on the PC and sent automatically when the internet returns. Admins can see them arrive on Desktop Tills.
